Customer_Intent: Customer wants to know the current status of a specific order and when it is expected to arrive.
Business_Goal: Reduce manual order lookup effort and provide a consistent response based on current operational data.

Customer_Intent: Customer reports that an order has not arrived as expected and wants to know the current situation and what happens next.
Business_Goal: Provide a consistent response by combining current shipment data with the applicable Shipping Policy.
Data_Sources: Customer Request; Order Management System; Shipping Policy

Customer_Intent: Customer reports that the parcel was not received although operational data shows it as delivered.
Business_Goal: Support correct handling of delivery disputes using verified operational data and the applicable Shipping Policy.
Data_Sources: Customer Request; Order Management System; Shipping Policy

Customer_Intent: Customer wants to know whether a specific purchased item can be returned.
Business_Goal: Apply return rules consistently to the relevant order and item facts and provide a reliable eligibility explanation.
Data_Sources: Customer Request; Order Management System; Returns Policy

Customer_Intent: Customer wants instructions for how to return an item.
Business_Goal: Reduce repetitive manual explanations by providing the applicable approved return procedure consistently.
Data_Sources: Customer Request; Returns Policy; Order Management System

Use_Case_Name: Handle Refund Eligibility or Refund Request
Customer_Intent: Customer wants to know whether a refund is possible for a specific case or asks support to issue a refund.
Business_Goal: Provide policy-grounded refund information and support correct handling of cases that require a human decision or action.
Data_Sources: Customer Request; Order Management System; Refund Policy; Business Rules

Customer_Intent: Customer asks a general informational question about Shipping, Returns, or Refund Policy that does not require an order-specific decision or business action.
Business_Goal: Reduce repetitive policy lookups and explanations by providing consistent answers grounded in approved company policies.
Data_Sources: Customer Request; Shipping Policy; Returns Policy; Refund Policy
